videos.desc: In a grassy back garden ringed by a wooden fence, a young man in a cap sets up over a coloured ball balanced on a batting tee, swings a blue aluminium bat and sends the ball flying high over the lawn. The camera follows the ball into the grey sky, and he stands watching where it lands among the other balls scattered on the grass.
videos.said: Watch him ball. Whoa, watch him hit the ball.

videos.desc: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.

In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.

A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

A stone castle courtyard at dusk under a purple sky. A young woman with long braids, in a steel breastplate over a maroon leather jacket, black leather trousers and tall boots, draws a longbow and shoots; her arrow hits a round target on a wooden log among several arrows clustered in its red centre, and splinters fly. She lowers the bow, turns and grins proudly. A young man in a padded navy tunic holding another bow watches behind her, and a fire burns in an iron basket under a stone arch.

A women's rugby match on a green pitch on a sunny day, with a white clubhouse, a picket fence and a flat-topped mountain under a cloud behind. A young woman in a blue jersey and white shorts, her hair in a bun, charges forward with the ball tucked under her arm and pushes an opponent in a white shirt and navy shorts away with her hand, shouting with a fierce face. She breaks past her and sprints on towards the camera while turf flies from her boots and the opponent is left behind.

At night on a baseball field lit by tall floodlights, seen from behind home plate, a batter in a helmet and dark gloves stands at the right edge with a wooden bat raised. In the middle of the field the pitcher in a white uniform throws, his leg kicking up behind him, and the white ball flies towards the batter. The batter swings, the ball flies high up into the dark blue sky, and the pitcher turns round to watch it. An empty grandstand and palm trees stand behind the field.

On an outdoor basketball court with a blue surface and a green metal fence at dusk, a young man in a blue sleeveless top and black shorts, seen from behind, holds the ball above his head. A young woman with long curly hair, in a red crop top and black shorts, stretches one arm high with her mouth open, shouting for the ball. She then runs up close to him and raises both arms high while he keeps the ball above his head. Two young men stand watching by the fence.

On a sandy beach at sunset under a pink and orange sky, a tall young man in a black T-shirt and white shorts stretches one arm out and waves someone over. A smiling young woman in a mustard top and navy track trousers comes towards him barefoot, pulling on her jacket. He turns and points towards the game, and she walks after him with the jacket in her hand. People play football by the sea behind them, a brightly painted wooden boat lies on the sand and a white wall with a lamp post runs along the right.

On a wet wooden jetty by a wide river, a young woman in a white vest and black shorts stands still while two teammates tie a long strip of bright red cloth around her upper arm. When they let go, she looks down at the red band on her arm and smiles, its long ends hanging down. Around her rows of young rowers in white vests hold wooden oars upright, rowing boats lie on the dock and a timber boathouse with a board of gold names stands behind.

In an indoor rink a young women's ice hockey player in a white and navy jersey and a navy helmet with a face cage skates hard along the white wall around the rink, her stick across her body, with a yellow strip along its bottom. She turns away from the wall and skates on past the camera. Behind her another player lies on the ice. Above the wall, fans behind tall glass panels cheer and bang on the glass, and a coach in a dark suit shouts from the bench.

In a dark laboratory a brass-coloured bullet with a copper tip passes through a red apple on a steel rod. Its far side bursts open in a spray of white flesh and juice, and a ring of air and water ripples around the bullet as it flies on and out of view. Water drops fall in straight lines from above, a block of ice smokes at the base, small metal sensors with red laser beams stand on the bench, and a sheet of crumpled gold foil hangs behind. Apple pieces lie scattered on the bench.

In a floodlit stadium in the rain, a referee in a yellow shirt with a whistle in her mouth and a player in a dark navy kit kneel face to face in the mud, staring at a coin on the wet ground between them. The coin spins and comes to rest standing on its edge in the mud. The player gasps with her mouth wide open and puts her hand down on the ground, and the referee stares in surprise. Behind them a line of players in maroon kits waits in front of the packed stand.

A night women's football match in heavy snow, seen from inside the goal through the white net. A player in a white shirt and black shorts leaps and heads an orange ball towards the goal; it flies high towards the net. The goalkeeper in green dives across with her gloves stretched out and lands face down on the snow, while the player lands and throws both arms up, cheering. Defenders in navy stand behind. The snowy pitch is lit by rows of bright floodlights, and the stands behind are packed with fans.

On a muddy rugby pitch under dark storm clouds, a young player in a striped muddy jersey with a long braid grabs an opponent round the hips and brings her crashing down into the mud as the ball flies loose. Both players slide through the puddles, then lie in the mud laughing and push themselves up onto their hands and knees while teammates run up. Spectators under umbrellas cheer on the touchline, and a referee in green runs towards them with one arm raised.

At night on a frozen lake, a referee's arm in a black and white striped sleeve drops a black puck between two young women in helmets, one in a red jersey and one in blue, who crouch face to face with their sticks on the clear ice. They fight for the puck, and the player in blue skates away with it. The view moves to the spectators in fur hats behind a snow bank lit by torches, with a dog, a raised lantern and a drum, under green northern lights and snowy mountains.

In an ice hockey game on a frozen lake in winter, a young goalkeeper in a cream wool jumper, knitted hat and old leather pads throws himself across the ice in front of a small wooden goal and blocks the puck with his stick and pads. Young players in woolly hats and padded jackets jab at the puck, spraying ice, then tumble over him. He lies on the ice laughing as the crowd behind raises their arms and cheers beside a fire burning in a metal barrel, with snowy pine forest beyond.

Inside a small boxing hall packed with spectators on wooden benches, two young boxers in white vests, one with brown gloves and one with black gloves, stand face to face. A referee in a white shirt, black bow tie and black trousers stands between them, pushes them apart with both hands, and they move out of sight. He stands alone in the middle of the ring with both arms stretched straight out to the sides and looks around sternly. White ropes run across the ring, and lamps hang over the crowd.

At a sailing race on a rough grey sea with white-capped waves, a racing yacht heels hard as it turns tightly around a huge orange inflatable buoy, passing right beside it. A young woman in a red sailing jacket and black waterproof trousers leans out over the edge of the deck holding a rope, with more crew in red behind her. The yacht sweeps past the buoy, and spray bursts up along its side. Other yachts with white sails race in the distance.

An outdoor tennis court under dark grey clouds. A ball machine on the right fires a huge stream of yellow tennis balls into the air, and dozens and dozens of them fly across the sky and bounce all over the green court. A young woman in a white top and navy skirt swings her racket at them, then stops and laughs. A young man in green runs in from the side, grabs the ball machine and laughs too. More players stand at the far fence by a bench with bags.

An outdoor basketball court at dusk with blue and orange paint, a wire fence and tall flats behind. A tall young man in a white vest and black shorts rises in an enormous jump, one arm fully stretched up with the ball above the rim, reaches the highest point, slams the ball through the hoop and hangs on the rim. He drops back down and lands in a deep crouch. A shorter young man in a navy kit stands nearby, and a row of friends in bright jackets by the fence cheer with raised arms.

A five-a-side football pitch in a netted cage on a city rooftop at night, lit by floodlights. A young woman goalkeeper in a blue shirt, black shorts and gloves dives sideways high in the air and stretches one arm up to tip the ball away from the goal. She lands on the artificial grass and smiles. A young man in a white shirt and maroon shorts, who has just kicked the ball, holds his head, then laughs and walks towards her. Water bottles stand by the post and lit towers fill the background.

A village cricket ground under a huge black storm cloud. Ground staff in navy rain jackets pull a large white cover across the wet pitch, leaning hard into it. Two cricket players in white walk off the wet grass: a young woman carrying her helmet and smiling, and a young man lifting his helmet and looking up at the sky. Puddles lie on the field, a boundary rope runs across the grass, and spectators with umbrellas stand by a white pavilion.

An amateur football match under floodlights at dusk. On the muddy touchline a fresh player in a clean blue kit slaps hands with a tired teammate whose blue kit is covered in mud, then jogs past him onto the pitch. The muddy player walks slowly off the pitch, breathing hard. Beside the dugout players in orange training bibs and a young woman in a black jacket clap. White lines cross the worn grass, and autumn trees and a red brick building stand behind under a deep blue sky.
